answer_1.quote: Recently, neutralized summarization was proposed to mitigate media bias by generating a neutralized summary given multiple articles that frame the same story from liberal or conservative viewpoints.

answer_2.quote: The automatic evaluation aims to evaluate the summarization models from the perspective of content preservation and bias mitigation. To evaluate content preservation, we calculate Rouge scores and BLEU score... As bias can be induced by both emotional language and biased information... we evaluate both lexical-level bias and content-level informational bias, by calculating the arousal scores and polarization score respectively.

answer_4.quote: The human evaluation aims to evaluate the generated summaries from three perspectives: bias mitigation, content semantics, and language quality. Specifically, we design six questions regarding lexical bias, informational bias, content non-hallucination, content recovery, language fluency, and language coherency. After collecting the evaluation scores from human annotators...
answer_4.guideline: Six questions on lexical bias, informational bias, content non-hallucination, content recovery, language fluency, and language coherency.
